What we do  ·  AI Cybersecurity How long were they inside?

For organizations that cannot absorb a public failure. We run detection and response around the clock and measure dwell time, meaning how long an attacker stays inside before anyone notices. An independent party tests how well we do it.

24/7 MDR · FIXED-SCOPE ASSESSMENTSDWELL TIME MEASURED, REPORTED QUARTERLYTESTED INDEPENDENTLY
Why this pillar exists

The path in is rarely the part that hurts.

Almost every entry vector on this page is survivable. What decides the outcome is how long the path stayed invisible afterward, and whether a gate existed where it mattered.

01

Coverage is a placement problem

Each path is defeated at a different stage. Buying one tool and calling it coverage leaves the stages that tool does not sit at completely unwatched.

02

The attacker arrives as a person

A convincing request from a familiar voice does not look like an intrusion at any stage a technical control is watching.

03

Operational technology cannot be patched on demand

In plants and control systems (operational technology, or OT), availability outranks confidentiality and maintenance windows come quarterly. A useful recommendation has to fit that.

The boundary

We run it. An independent party tests it.

Three steps. Orvix does the first and the third. The second sits with a tester who does not report to our operations team.

STEP 01 · ORVIX

We operate and assess

We run Managed Detection & Response around the clock, and we deliver the fixed-scope Human Risk and OT Security assessments.

STEP 02 · INDEPENDENT TESTER

An independent party tests it

The effectiveness of the service we run is tested by a party outside our operations team. When a regulator or board needs the result to carry weight, that party is fully independent of Orvix.

STEP 03 · ORVIX

We close what the test found

Gaps from the test become engineering work with a date against each one. The tester, not Orvix, runs the re-test.

We ask every supplier to keep operation and testing apart. Our own service is held to that rule first.

Questions we are asked

Before you ask us.

Is Orvix an MSSP (managed security service provider)?
Yes, for detection and response: we operate it as a managed security service. The assurance opinion on our own operation comes from a party outside the team that runs it, which is what gives the result its weight.
Where do you deliver from?
From the region. In licensed markets, operations run through a licensed partner under its own license, named in the contract. Where in-country delivery or national staffing is mandated, the partner meets that requirement and the contract states it.
How is this different from the assurance pillar?
This pillar operates and tests security. AI Assurance gives opinions on AI systems. We keep the two separate, including internally, so that no opinion is written by the team that runs the thing being judged.
